## Highlights

- Keep long Desktop session titles readable on a separate full-width row in the sidebar and floating mini-window.
- Use native icon buttons and tooltips for familiar sidebar actions, including Search, Refresh, Settings, Float, Dock and information. Keep text for Banked Resets, account linking and other less obvious operations.
- Keep successful Desktop Limits compact: show the update time and quota data without a persistent account/model scope explanation. Errors, sign-in guidance and reset-credit safeguards are preserved.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing toolbar pin appearances, favorites, account bindings and scoped preferences are preserved.
- The verified host targets remain OpenCode 1.19.5 and 2.2.6. This release does not upgrade OpenCode itself.
- Reopen clients if their existing plugin instance still reports the previous Navigator version.
- Terminal users should keep their primary Nerd Font and the additional Navigator Corners font for rounded multiline selections. Install the bundled corner font on the machine displaying the terminal and fully restart the terminal after font changes; Text mode remains available without it.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at adc49274b133428e859d269471c3654a1b1d13c1 -->

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.27.2...v0.27.3

## Highlights

- Desktop Settings keep long labels, fields and actions inside their rows at narrow widths.
- Drag handles reorder sections, Quick Actions, toolbar pins and button icons. Keyboard users can pick up with Space, move with Up/Down and drop with Space; Escape cancels.
- TUI version labels and Desktop About show download/install progress. Percentages appear only with real byte totals; otherwise the active stage is shown.
- Desktop Todo uses native-style status indicators and muted, struck-through completed/cancelled tasks. Section arrows and loading indicators follow the host UI-kit.
- Model and reasoning-effort selection stays below chat in Desktop; Navigator Limits still follow the selected model.

## Upgrade notes

- Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator. Supported hosts remain OpenCode 1.19.5 and 2.2.6.
- No settings migration is required. Favorites, account bindings, toolbar pins and scoped preferences are preserved.
- Native Todo editing remains owned by chat. Search and filter tabs stay in Navigator because Desktop does not expose an extension point inside its Todo popover.
- Terminal users should retain their primary Nerd Font and the additional Navigator Corners font for rounded multiline selections. Install the bundled corner font on the machine displaying the terminal and fully restart the terminal after a font change; Text mode remains available without it.

releases.name: v0.27.1 — Native Desktop controls and credit expiry
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Drag the Desktop mini-window by its header or move handle. Its surface and controls now follow OpenCode's light and dark themes.
- Use native switches and selectors for Skill trust and Todo configuration, with host-themed multiline inputs.
- See how long banked reset credits remain valid, with a remaining-lifetime scale and expiry countdown. Missing dates stay explicit; expired credits cannot be selected for review.

## Upgrade notes

- Supported hosts remain OpenCode TUI 1.19.5 and 2.2.6, with experimental Desktop 2.2.6. No host upgrade is required by this patch.
- Existing preferences, account bindings and pending reset attempts are preserved. Reset consumption still requires explicit confirmation.
- Desktop needs no terminal font. TUI multiline rounded selections still require the bundled Navigator Corners font; keep your primary Nerd Font selected and fully restart the terminal after installing or updating that font.
- Reopen OpenCode after updating Navigator to load the new plugin version.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.27.0...v0.27.1

releases.name: v0.27.0 — Navigator comes to Desktop
releases.body:
# Navigator comes to Desktop

## Highlights

- Open Navigator in OpenCode Desktop as a native panel or an opt-in mini-window inside the app. Keep your selected session, filters and monitoring when moving between them.
- Use Search Everything, Skills, MCP groups and presets, Quick Actions and customizable toolbar pins in Desktop, alongside the existing TUI interface.
- Configure scope-aware sections, groups, trust and profiles in native Settings. Browse release history, revisit the seven-slide guide and review editable GitHub Bug reports.
- View verified provider/account quotas, link the intended account and confirm banked resets explicitly. Remote sessions never borrow a local provider account.
- Avoid false configuration errors from superseded Desktop refreshes while retaining genuine errors and retry guidance.

## Upgrade notes

- Verified hosts: OpenCode TUI 1.19.5 and 2.2.6; experimental OpenCode Desktop 2.2.6. Browser Web and detached OS windows are not supported targets.
- Desktop loads the GUI from the Navigator package in its global server configuration. A CLI-only entry in `cli.json` does not enable Desktop. See the README's Experimental OpenCode Desktop section before changing configuration shared with OpenCode 1.x.
- Existing private preferences, account bindings, reset attempts and the read-only legacy Todo archive are preserved. Use Reload preferences to import changes saved by another local Navigator instance.
- TUI rounded multiline selections still require the bundled OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal. Install or update it with `opencode-navigator-font`, keep your primary Nerd Font selected, and fully restart the terminal. Without the extra font, disable Multiline corner font or use Text fallback. Desktop does not need terminal fonts.
- Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator to load the new plugin version.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.26.0...v0.27.0

## Highlights

- Subagents use OpenCode 2's native execution-start time for accurate active durations, including children already running when Navigator opens. Missing native timing keeps the observed-duration fallback.
- Interrupted Subagent executions stay marked as Cancelled in Recent.
- Background retries no longer accumulate cancellation listeners, and preferences loading no longer waits indefinitely on recovery markers.

## Upgrade notes

- Supported hosts remain OpenCode **1.19.5** and **2.2.5**. Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator.
- Keep your primary Nerd Font selected and install **OpenCode Navigator Corners** on the machine displaying the terminal for rounded multiline selections. This release does not change the font; existing installations do not need a font update. After installing or updating the font, fully restart the terminal. Text mode and the separate multiline-corner switch remain available.
- Updating the package does not update a pinned local-source installation automatically; use Navigator's confirmed update flow for that installation.
